title: bdb2027-outputs
subtitle: Audited aggregate result tables for a Big Data Bowl 2027 writeup
description: Aggregate, test-level result tables (one row per Combine test x on-field outcome x position group; no player rows) behind the NFL Big Data Bowl 2027 notebook 'Read the Combine through body size'. scorecard_full.csv: every test x outcome cell with size-controlled rank correlation, 95% CI, permutation p, Benjamini-Hochberg q, held-out-class check, MDE and verdict. scorecard.csv: the one test per result shown in the scorecard figure. scorecard_weight.csv: weight against on-field results with height and draft year held fixed. figs/fig1_gate_wr.png: saved gate figure used when the competition data is not attached. No raw competition data is included.

resources.description: Scorecard rows, one test per result (aggregate)
